ai_summary: MIUI gallery photo-AI plugin (version 1.8.7.4.0-global) exposing four families of on-device algorithms: (1) MiBrain portrait relighting rendered by a GLES light-map shader inside librelight_only_extraphoto.so, driven through libmibrain_relighting_jni.so and the AILAB_PLI_* C API; (2) depth-based dual-camera bokeh via Megvii wa::Refocus (classical CoC/matting/blur, no DNN), MiAlgo and MediaTek variants; (3) ArcSoft portrait-lighting/dual-cam libraries; (4) document-photo scan/enhance/dewarp/handwrite removal via libdoc_photo_process.so (MACE + OpenCL) with a shipped Snapdragon SNPE DLC asset (document_model.dlc) whose full 512x512x3->512x512x1 HED/mobilenet_v2_skip graph and 314,289 bytes of uint8 weights were decoded. The DLC graph is executed end-to-end in JAX with the real dequantised weights; relighting and bokeh are reimplemented at the documented architecture level.

reimplementation.limitations: document_hed.py executes the full decoded SNPE DLC graph with real dequantised weights and matches all declared shapes, but no SNPE runtime exists on this host for numeric comparison. relighting.py and bokeh.py are ARCHITECTURE_ONLY: the GLES relight renderer math is taken from the extracted shader, but light-pattern textures and AILAB_PLI preprocessing are opaque; the bokeh pipeline implements thin-lens CoC + aperture-spot depth-bin blur, while the vendor's calibrated CoC curve, SGBM/WLS disparity and Kepler matting are not reimplemented. No bit-exactness is claimed. The JAX document model reproduces the shipped SNPE DLC export (1x512x512x3 -> 1x512x512x1); the shipping MACE scan model used by libdoc_photo_process.so is 1x384x384x3 -> 1x384x384x2 and its weights remain embedded in the library. Relighting has no gesture-driven light movement in this build (setLightSource is a no-op; the JNI always centres the light), and bokeh focus/f-number mapping is reproduced from the Java tables while the vendor CoC calibration is unavailable.

unknowns: Which component consumes document_model.dlc on this build: libdoc_photo_process.so is a MACE runtime with no SNPE/.dlc parser strings; the DLC is copied to filesDir/doc_model/dlc and passed to DocumentProcessJNI.nativeInit, so the SNPE consumer may be absent from this build or implemented without string signatures.

MACE document model files (hed_model, enhance_model, dewarp_coarse/fine, demoiring, segment, inpaint_coarse/fine, handwrite) are not shipped as files in the APK; only names and parts of the EdgeDet graph are embedded. Weights not extracted.
librelight_only_extraphoto.so 82.9 MB .data payload: role (light-pattern textures / precomputed 3D portrait lighting tables) and format not decoded; no container magic or carve hit.
AILAB_PLI_Init/PreProcess/Process internals: face/depth analysis, light-source mapping (AdjustLightPos) and per-effect light textures are not recovered.
Relighting effect texture assets for relightingType 0x03..0x18 / movie 0x20..0x28 are not present as image assets in the APK (only icon.png/config.json).
Megvii/MTK bokeh calibrated CoC curve and calibration constants (StructD/StructO/paramL) plus SGBM/WLS disparity and AlphaRefineKepler matting parameters are undocumented and not reimplemented.
ArcSoft portrait lighting / dual-cam refocus model or compiled-in weights were not extracted (no carveable container in the 15.6 MB / 11.7 MB libs).
libmotion_photo_mace.so mmaps an external model data file that is not shipped in the APK.
libmibokeh_gallery.so references a MACE bokeh engine (bokeh_mace: engine_=) but no bokeh model asset is shipped; model path/format unknown.
No SNPE, MACE or wa::Refocus runtime is available on this host, so none of the vendor pipelines could be numerically cross-checked.

Document scan model in the shipping MACE runtime is 1x384x384x3 -> 1x384x384x2 (descriptors at file offsets 0x437000/0x437028), while the shipped SNPE DLC is 1x512x512x3 -> 1x512x512x1; the DLC's 512 spatial size matches the EnhanceModel input, and no SNPE/DLC consumer is observable in libdoc_photo_process.so.

Brain relighting does not apply the touch light-source gesture in this build: MiBrainRelightingProcessor.setLightSource is empty, supportAdjustLightSource() returns false, and the JNI always calls setBrainRelightingLightSource(W/2,H/2,W,H). Only the ArcSoft processors forward real gesture coordinates.

data_pipelines.name: Document photo (scan -> crop/warp -> enhance/dewarp/de-handwrite -> JPEG)

source.trigger: DocPhotoActivity.onCheckPermissionSucceed -> Storage.fromIntent -> DocPhotoManager.parsePhotoAsync; DocPhotoPostProcessingActivity for raw capture post-processing
source.input_format: JPEG/HEIF via ContentResolver InputStream; EXIF orientation; document state in XMP (docPhoto version/enhanceType/cropPoints/rawLength/privacyWatermark) and EXIF docPhoto=1

transport.format: Android Bitmap, ARGB_8888 only (native rejects format != ANDROID_BITMAP_FORMAT_RGBA_8888=1); native staging is RGB 3 bytes/pixel (R,G,B order); output is a new ARGB_8888 Bitmap with alpha 0xFF and the source ColorSpace
transport.native_image: cv::Mat CV_8UC3 over the RGB staging buffer
transport.yuv_variant: exported nativeScanDocumentYUV / nativeCropAndEnhanceYUV take a byte[] (NV21: Y plane + interleaved VU) plus width/height; not declared in this APK's DocumentProcessJNI dex class
transport.threads: AsyncTask.THREAD_POOL_EXECUTOR for parse/preview; ExportTask AsyncTask for save; DocProcessor.SafeProcessor serialises native calls on mLock; release on a raw new Thread

preprocessing: BitmapFactory.decodeStream with inSampleSize from ImageUtils.computeInSampleInfo (preview) or BigBitmapLoadUtils.calculateInSampleSize memory budget (save), then EXIF rotation
Scan points returned in delegate-bitmap space; MatrixUtils.mapPoints(points, inverse(delegateMatrix)) converts them to raw full-resolution un-rotated pixel space before crop
Native RGBA8888 -> RGB (ld4/st3, alpha dropped) -> cv::Mat CV_8UC3
doEdgeDet resizes to 384x384 (mov w8,#0x180) with cv::resize (0x383520) and pads; normalisation to [0,1] is inside the MACE graph (inferred from the DLC's leading Div 255)
Crop validates the 4-point polygon (30.0f angle threshold), computes output size from quad + cached aspect ratio, warps with cv::getPerspectiveTransform/warpPerspective
jni_methods: nativeScanDocumentBitmap(long handle, Bitmap bmp, int documentType, float[] points, int mode) -> int : (JLandroid/graphics/Bitmap;I[FI)I
nativeCropImageBitmap(long, Bitmap, float[] points, int documentType) -> Bitmap : (JLandroid/graphics/Bitmap;[FI)Landroid/graphics/Bitmap;
nativeCropAndEnhanceBitmap(long, Bitmap, float[] points, int enhanceType, int documentType, boolean) -> Bitmap : (JLandroid/graphics/Bitmap;[FIIZ)Landroid/graphics/Bitmap;
nativeEnhanceBitmap(long, Bitmap, int enhanceType, boolean) -> int : (JLandroid/graphics/Bitmap;IZ)I
